answer: Each identity anchors to a bounty-completion streak: bounties completed and paid over years, with the platforms confirming the record. The raven that hunts every day eats well, and a bounty hunter with a long streak is the same. An atlas shows the world as it is, and a bounty record shows the hunter as they are: one completion at a time. The canyon of a farm's streaks is deep and narrow: all their completions are recent, all on the same platform, all for the same trivial tasks, and the platforms' own records expose the pattern.
